title: 第50章 蔡家邀请第51章 蔡家族人
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
这时的卫克脑子开始宕机，自己竟然得罪一个手握金色令牌的天雷宗弟子，这无疑是想自我了结啊！
他缓了缓神，他又心中犯疑，天雷宗的金色令牌不是谁都能拿的。
据他了解，弟子中最少是核心弟子，还有的是总殿长老等等才可拥有，可赶宇如此年轻，就是生下来就修炼，也不可能啊？是超级妖孽？他现在思绪混乱，毫无头绪。
要么是，他突然想到一种可能，特殊弟子！
实际上每个大宗门都有些特弟子，要么来路特殊，要么关系特殊，要么背景特殊。
对，对！
卫克想到的最大可能就是这小子是特殊弟子！
至于有人冒充，那基本不可能，若有人敢冒充天雷宗的金牌弟子，那在凡武大陆基本上是算活到头了。
这时，那个钱方一看卫克呆呆傻傻，一副被吃瘪的样子，不明所以，想讨好上司，几步冲了过来，一手举刀吹向赵宇，一手对着赵宇手中的令牌抓了过去，同时嘴里还骂骂咧咧道：“一块什么劳什子破烂玩意，给我拿过来。”
赵宇正憋着一口气还没出来呢，一看这个蠢货冲上来送菜，心中大感痛快，终于可以杀鸡儆猴了！
就在这一瞬间，忽见一道金光闪过，只听钱方“啊”
地一声惨叫，一条胳膊掉到地上。
随着一声惨叫，顿时众人的目光都看向钱方，只见钱方一边嚎叫，一边用一只手死死握住那只不停喷血的断臂。
这时，卫克还算机敏，马上冲过去找了块布条缚住了钱方那流血的伤口，又赶忙拿出丹药喂给钱方。
同时目光冷冽地看着赵宇，说道：“赵公子是否太过分了？钱方毕竟是我城卫所一位官军，赵公子怎能轻易下此重手？”
赵宇仍摆出一副高高在上的样子，佯怒道：“卫克，你的眼睛长在何处？你难道没有看见是他先用刀砍我，还想夺我令牌，这令牌是他一个小小护卫可抢夺的？我就是宰了他也是合情合理。
你还敢责问我？他是你下属吧？我还没有治你管教无方的罪呢，你倒来个倒打一耙。”
卫克因为不明底细，他也不敢再深究下去，不然倒霉的一定是他，若赵宇真是个手握金牌的特殊弟子，他得罪对方，其结果不可测啊。
若是站在赵宇后面的“身后人”
出手，别说是他卫克，就是整个家族都有可能灰飞烟灭。

今天的亏只能吃了，今天受的气只能咽了。
今日是他自作自受，一开始是他出阴招要谋害蔡家和赵宇。
卫克克制着满腔怒火，依旧对赵宇一抱拳：“赵公子，今日得罪了，是我的失责，抱歉了！
容日后登门赔罪，今天公务繁忙，我们先告辞了，”
说完让两个城卫抬着钱方转头而去。
所有围观的人，特别是蔡家众人脑烧得晕头转向，从开始被人下套、欺负、打压。
到现在剧情演着演着怎么完全转变了？整个剧情迂回曲折，高潮迭起。
赵宇又变成天雷宗金牌弟子了，又看到卫灰溜溜地离去，他们脑回路这次真是懵逼了！
看着卫克离开，其他的城卫当然不可能再去阻拦蔡家，特别对赵宇更是客气。
蔡忠一看忙催着蔡家众人赶快入城回府，免得再生事端。
而四周围观的众人也一哄而散。
content_en:
At this time, Wei Ke's mind began to shut down. He actually offended a disciple of the Tianlei Sect who was holding a golden token. This was undoubtedly an attempt to kill himself!
He calmed down, but he was suspicious again. Not everyone can take the golden token of Tianlei Sect.
As far as he understood, at least the core disciples among the disciples, and some could only be possessed by the elders of the main hall, etc. But Qianyu was so young, even if he was born to cultivate, it would be impossible? A super monster? His thoughts are confused now and he has no clue.
Or, he suddenly thought of a possibility, a special disciple!
In fact, every major sect has some special disciples, either with special origins, special connections, or special backgrounds.
Yes, yes!
The biggest possibility that Wei Ke thought of was that this kid was a special disciple!
As for someone pretending to be one, that's basically impossible. If someone dares to pretend to be a gold medal disciple of Tianlei Sect, their life in the Mortal Martial Continent will basically end.
At this time, Qian Fang saw Wei Ke dumbfounded and looked defeated. He didn't know why, and wanted to please his boss. He rushed over in a few steps, raised the knife in one hand and blew it at Zhao Yu, and grabbed the token in Zhao Yu's hand with the other hand. At the same time, he cursed and said: "Bring me a piece of rags."
Zhao Yu was holding his breath and hadn't come out yet. When he saw this idiot rushing up to deliver the food, he felt very happy. He could finally scare the monkeys!
At this moment, a golden light suddenly flashed by, and Qian Fang heard "Ah"
There was a scream and an arm fell to the ground.
Following a scream, everyone's eyes suddenly turned to Qian Fang. Qian Fang was howling while tightly holding the severed arm that kept spurting blood with one hand.
At this time, Wei Ke was still alert and rushed over to find a piece of cloth to tie Qian Fang's bleeding wound, and then quickly took out the elixir and fed it to Qian Fang.
At the same time, he looked at Zhao Yu with cold eyes and said, "Did Mr. Zhao go too far? After all, Qian Fang is an officer of our city guard station. How could Mr. Zhao take such a heavy blow so easily?"
Zhao Yu still put on a condescending look and pretended to be angry: "Weike, where are your eyes? Didn't you see that he slashed me with a knife first and then wanted to take away my token? This token can only be snatched by his little guard? It is reasonable for me to kill him."
Do you still dare to question me? Is he your subordinate? I haven't punished you for your lack of discipline, but you have to punish me. "
Because Wei Ke didn't know the details, he didn't dare to dig deeper, otherwise he would be the unlucky one. If Zhao Yu was really a special disciple with a gold medal, and he offended the other party, the consequences would be unpredictable.
If it is the "person behind" standing behind Zhao Yu
If he takes action, let alone Wei Ke, the entire family may be wiped out.
Today's losses can only be eaten, and today's anger can only be swallowed.
Today was his own fault. In the beginning, he was the one who plotted to kill the Cai family and Zhao Yu.
Wei Ke suppressed his anger and still hugged Zhao Yu: "Mr. Zhao, I offended you today. It's my fault. I'm sorry!
I'll come to apologize later. I'm busy with business today, so we'll take our leave now."
After saying that, he asked the two city guards to carry Qian Fang and turned away.
All the people watching, especially the Cai family, were so dizzy that they were tricked, bullied, and suppressed from the beginning.
How come the plot has completely changed since then? The whole plot has twists and turns and climaxes one after another.
Zhao Yu became a gold medal disciple of Tianlei Sect again, and saw Wei leaving in despair. Their brains were really confused this time!
Watching Wei Ke leave, the other city guards certainly couldn't stop the Cai family anymore, and they were especially polite to Zhao Yu.
When Cai Zhong saw it, he hurriedly urged everyone in the Cai family to enter the city and return home quickly to avoid further trouble.
And the people watching all around also dispersed in a hurry.
